captions.detailed: A portal axle hub-reduction assembly featuring a black vertical housing that offsets the drive center downward. An upper input shaft with a splined end enters the rear of the housing, while a lower output wheel hub assembly with five mounting studs and a light grey brake disc/flange extends from the front. The input shaft and the wheel hub are designed to rotate continuously around their respective parallel, offset axes.
captions.instruction: Create a portal axle hub-reduction unit with a vertical offset housing. The model should feature a continuous-rotation input shaft at the top rear, and a continuous-rotation wheel hub with five mounting studs on a grey flange at the bottom front.
captions.factory: Construct a vertical housing by taking the union of two cylindrical sweeps offset vertically and lofting or bridging them. Extrude a splined input shaft from the upper rear port. Model the lower hub assembly by creating a grey cylindrical flange disk, adding five small circular studs patterned on its face, and attaching it to a central output shaft that projects from the lower front port of the housing.
